My experience with this so-called ‘KS Legal’ company has been extremely unprofessional and mentally exhausting. They repeatedly contacted me from random mobile numbers, spoke in an intimidating tone, and attempted to pressure me over a very small outstanding amount of just a few thousand rupees.

This behaviour is completely unacceptable. A legitimate financial or legal organisation follows a formal process, uses official communication channels, and provides proper documentation — not random numbers and harassment-style calls.

Their approach shows a lack of ethics, zero professionalism, and absolutely no respect for consumers. Many people who are already under financial stress end up feeling mentally tortured because of such tactics. No genuine company should treat individuals like this.

I strongly advise everyone to be cautious when dealing with such agencies. Always demand written communication, verify credentials, and don’t fall for pressure tactics from unknown callers
